name: coverage
description: Generate curated structural coverage and conservative end-to-end requirement proof reports for requirements, symbols, or grouped types. Use it to ask which requirements are tested end to end, how strong each requirement's evidence is (evidenceLevel: proved, tested, asserted or unverified), and what blocks the rest; use kb_find_gaps for a plain list of missing links and kb_check for rule violations. Reports include the compatible repair plan plus typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 actions; semantic and E2E actions remain review/execution work. Paginated plans identify incomplete scope and no mutation occurs.

options.description: Comma-separated requirement proof-status filter (tested, missing, unresolved, not_applicable); implies include-passing
Include one read-only legacy semantic migration preview batch
Maximum ranked predicate schemas per proposition
Print the edge cases derived from each requirement's typed claims, with their predicted outcome and covering scenarios
Read this KB dependency (a name from .kb/dependencies.json) instead of the project's own KB

name: graph
description: Run bounded graph traversal from one or more seed IDs across curated relationship types and return the nodes and edges reached. Use it to follow links from IDs you already have, such as a requirement to its scenarios and tests or a symbol to the requirements it implements; use kb_query to find entities by filter and kb_search to ask a question. Traversal stops at depth, maxNodes or maxEdges and then sets truncated. No mutation side effects.

description: Run KB validation rules and return violations, quality diagnostics, and typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 actions. Use before or after mutations and after source edits; checks remain read-only and never infer or apply actions from prose suggestions.
